hints.title: Single Candidate Elimination Logic
hints.text: If person a knows person b, then a cannot be the celebrity. If person a does not know person b, then b cannot be the celebrity.

hints.title: Linear Pass Candidate Reduction
hints.text: Compare candidates sequentially: initialize candidate to zero, and for each person i from one to n minus one, if candidate knows i, update candidate to i.

hints.title: Complete Celebrity Status Verification
hints.text: After selecting the candidate, verify against every person i. If the candidate knows i, or i does not know the candidate, return negative one. Otherwise return the candidate.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of people at the party
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying all pairs via knows(a, b) requires quadratic O(N^2) API calls which exceeds the call budget.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Eliminating one non-celebrity per API call isolates a single candidate in N-1 calls, requiring only 2N additional verification calls.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that each query eliminates exactly one person, reducing search from O(N^2) to O(N).
